summary: Hatched painted island at a shopping centre corner; nowhere to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Shopping centre wall beside it; no homes close, but fully exposed to the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: A short loop of kerb around a painted hatched island; no room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Shopping centre service traffic and Grosvenor Road at the corner.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped; no cars park here.

sun_shade: Open; one tree and the centre wall shade the west side.
